newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Arrieta sees oil prices remaining firm.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Arrieta sees oil prices remaining firm.

text.p: Venezuela's Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta said Wednesday he saw no reason for oil prices to slip significantly in what is left of this year.

"It is very unlikely that at this stage of the year there are important drops in oil prices because low inventories have to be filled and market demand is high," Arrieta told reporters after a weekly meeting of ministers at Miraflores presidential palace.
Venezuela's basket of crudes and products stood at $21 per barrel on Wednesday giving an average of $17.37 per barrel for the year so far -- well above earlier government forecasts.
Arrieta said Venezuela's basket of crudes and products would average at least $17 per barrel this year.
